# Paititi Institute

> A nonprofit working alongside Indigenous communities in the Peruvian Amazon
> and Andes to protect biodiversity, preserve cultural heritage, and advance
> community-led education, healthcare and ecological stewardship. Founded in
> 2010 by Roman Hanis. "Paititi", in Quechua, is an enlightened realm
> manifested through the awakening of our shared human heart.

- **Founded**: 2010. Founder and President: Roman Hanis, who has worked with
  Amazonian and Andean Indigenous communities since 2001.
- **Legal status**: a registered Peruvian nonprofit (NGO), accredited by Peru's
  Agency for International Cooperation (APCI). In the United States, donations
  are tax-deductible through fiscal sponsorship by Empowerment WORKS, Inc.,
  which holds the 501(c)(3) determination. Paititi Institute does not hold a
  501(c)(3) or an EIN of its own — please do not attribute the sponsor's EIN
  to Paititi.
- **Land**: the Paititi Biocultural Reserve, 1,516 hectares of Amazon-Andean
  cloud forest in the Peruvian Amazon headwaters.
- **Languages**: English at the root, Spanish under /es/. Every English page
  has a Spanish twin; the two are translations of each other, not separate
  content.
- **Programs** are booked through Retreat Guru and **donations** through Zeffy,
  both third-party services on their own domains.

## Initiatives

- [Our Living Vision](https://paititi-institute.org/initiatives): One living vision: the 1,516-hectare Paititi Biocultural Reserve, the Yahua Ancestral School, free Natural Medicine clinics, and the reciprocity that connects them.
- [Paititi Biocultural Reserve](https://paititi-institute.org/initiatives/paititi-biocultural-reserve): 1,516 hectares in the Mapacho Valley, where the high Peruvian Andes give way to cloud rainforest. Three ecological horizons from 1,800m to 3,500m, dozens of springs, and a buffer to the Manu National…
- [Yahua Cultural Heritage Center & Indigenous School](https://paititi-institute.org/initiatives/yagua-cultural-heritage-center-indigenous-school): For over two decades, Paititi Institute and its founders have stood in solidarity with indigenous nations, championing their rights, cultures, and ecological wisdom. Support the growth of the Yahua…
- [An Ancestral School for the Q'ero Nation](https://paititi-institute.org/initiatives/qero-nation-emergency-food-supply): Paititi Institute is extending its ancestral school initiative from the Yahua people in the Amazon to the Q'ero Nation in the high Andes — a living space where elders and children remain in daily…
- [Uniting the Elders and Children of the World](https://paititi-institute.org/initiatives/uniting-elders-and-children): The Seed of the Heart initiative began with the Yahua elders in the Amazon and has grown into a movement uniting elders and children across the world — through workshops, a children's book and the…
- [Emergency Relief for Nepal](https://paititi-institute.org/support/nepal-emergency): Families in the Rasuwa region of Nepal urgently need food, blankets, cooking supplies and emergency solar power. Paititi Institute is organizing relief with Lama Karma Tsultrim Sangpo and the Manang…
